explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/835 (Erdős–Rosenfeld): does some k > 2 admit a colouring of the k-subsets of [2k] with k+1 colours such that every (k+1)-set A sees all colours among its k-subsets? Property k encodes this exactly, using the k-subsets s ⊂ A, and the statement asserts ∃ k > 2, Property k. Faithful.
